## Pushed for review: Gerrit change 2681

https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2681 — "Pin fixture bare remotes that tests
local-clone" (commit d31a33a334fd, 19 files, +431/-56).

**`make verify` on the final tree: `19775 passed, 80 skipped, 2 errors` in 30m37s.** Lint and
typecheck green. The two errors are teardown failures of the report-only `_no_repo_root_leaks`
guard in two BYSTANDER tests neither of which this change touches: a `.tickets-tracker` symlink
into the main checkout appeared mid-run, which only `rebar init`'s linked-worktree branch
writes (`src/rebar/_commands/init.py:198` -> `_init_via_symlink`, `:591`). Removing it and
re-running both named tests plus all 17 modules this change touches gives 182/182 with nothing
recreated, so it is not this change and it cannot occur in CI (a normal clone never takes that
branch). Filed as `initial-adroit-xoni` (`21fa-446f-f49f-47b1`), linked `discovered_from` here.

Not closing until 2681 is `Verified +1` and merged, per the ordering policy.
